lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF may sell up to ₹3.41 crore, if all offered shares are sold, in the offer for sale.
Proceeds are unknown in cash terms until sale; the offer price is ₹1,352 and employee-portion shares sell at a discount.
The trigger is recent: shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, though these are shares, not cash.
They hold ₹7.95 crore retained (estimate, valued at offer price); the average cost of acquisition is unknown.
